articles.title: White House Room For Xi? New Report EXPOSES Trump's Red-Carpet SURRENDER To China During Visit
articles.description: Donald Trump’s grand welcome for Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington is facing fresh scrutiny after a Wall Street Journal report detailed unusual requests reportedly made by the Chinese side during Xi’s visit. According to the report, Xi’s schedule was built around his need for rest, with Chinese officials allegedly requesting a private “hold room” in the West Wing between events. The report also said a working lunch with Trump was canceled, creating a five-hour gap in the summit schedule. Xi’s brief visit to the National Archives reportedly lasted around 10 minutes despite preparations for a longer stay.

articles.description: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge on Saturday demanded dissolving the Lok Sabha and state Assemblies, saying that all the elections were illegal and even Prime Minister Modi, Home Minister Amit Shah and Chief Ministers of all the states were illegal. Modi is an illegal Prime Minister, Shah is an illegal minister, and all the chief ministers who have been elected anywhere are illegal. All of them should be dissolved, elections should be held, and elections should be conducted through ballot papers," he told reporters here. Kharge alleged that the EVMs were being misused and said that "their own people" are saying this.
